name: Edge-conditioned open-vocabulary generation with a one-character local copy channel
timing: Metadata counts and earlier reports inspected; frozen before fitting or scoring the new model on real Voynich data. Corpus is previously explored, not a fresh semantic holdout.
representation: Literal lowercase ASCII EVA characters; not established glyphs, phonemes, or language units.
parser: Paragraph P loci only; unknown/alternative chunks and drawing gaps break adjacency; never cross lines. Both comma split and join. Numeric folio stem groups all panels and recto/verso; nonnumeric fRos excluded with audit.
strata_reason: Three large known Currier/hand strata in pre-fit metadata inventory; other hands/unknowns have limited or mixed coverage. Section remains a potential confound.

reserve.assignment: Sort numeric folio stems lexicographically; index modulo five. Same assignment in both comma modes. Retain all rows of a physical leaf together.

word_base.band_reference: Retained clean run; not complete physical line

copy.source: Immediate previous token within retained run only
copy.mixture_fit: 30 EM iterations, initial copy weight 0.1; all pairs from training only

primary: Bits per next token conditional on observed past (teacher forcing); compare edge vs edge_copy per stratum, physical fold and comma mode. Also report leaf-balanced gain. This is predictive performance, not meaning.

matched_context_probe.conditioning: Replace previous token by a distinct training token with same ASCII length, final character and Currier/hand; sample by training frequency without consulting target. Edge probabilities remain identical. Descriptive probe, no causal or formal permutation p-value.

simulation.geometry: Condition on held-out clean-run lengths and stratum only, generate all token strings and lengths freely within runs. Do not condition on test word lengths or final/initial characters.
simulation.interval: Second and penultimate values of 30 draws; descriptive simulation range, not confidence or rejection of a historical family.

decision: Report every fixed metric and all folds. Numerical support for added copy channel requires positive pooled and leaf-balanced log-score gains in both comma modes and positive pooled gains in every fold. No semantic or originality claim follows, even on success.
limitations: Same known corpus, no external semantic truth
Not the published full Timm/Schinner algorithm
Section and layout effects incompletely controlled
Left-to-right transcript order does not establish scribal causation
Both models may leave unmodeled nonsemantic structures
